items.why: The report lists a band near 241 cm-1 in every spectrum (e.g. "241.30+-0.03 cm-1, FWHM 2.0") and tracks the "strongest band", but it never assigns it to A1'(Γ) or calls it the one-phonon peak.

Bands near 480.7, 531 and 582 cm-1 appear in the fitted lists, but the report never says they are the strongest features after the one-phonon peak, that they are missing at the 1.65 eV spectra, or that they are tied to the 2s resonances.
The report does not mention the B2s exciton or any incoming or outgoing resonance.
The report gives no assignment to Γ-phonon combinations (2E', A1'+E', 2A1') and does not mention intravalley Rydberg scattering.
The report does not place the low-energy spectra at the A1s exciton and does not compare absolute scattering intensities.
The caveats list is empty, and the report says nothing about parallel-minus-crossed subtraction artifacts.
The report has no caveat about weak peaks having uncertain multiphonon or defect assignments; it makes no assignments at all.
The questions list is empty; the report does not suggest finer excitation steps or reflectivity on the same spot.

wrong_claims.why: The report makes no assignments, so it never attributes the peaks to Si or hBN.
The report does not claim these peaks are equally present at the A1s resonance; the 1.65 eV fits list different bands.
